svg.title: CodeAlta Fleet in action
svg.desc: Your desktop and Bea's laptop connect to CodeAlta Server, which reaches the machines that run sessions: a Mac mini also paired directly with your desktop, a build box of team Infra, and a cloud runner that asks to join and is approved when it shows the same six words as your desktop. A session moves from the Mac mini to the build box, its history with it. Sessions travel encrypted end to end, relayed by the server or directly; the rules signed by your devices reach every machine, which checks them before it acts.

g.text: Approve if it shows the same six words:
a session, encrypted end to end
who may do what, signed by your devices
checked by each machine before it acts
